blockbuilder-explorer.visual_critic_note: Deliberate dark-theme design system with CSS custom properties, muted accent palette, and uppercase panel labels shows real craft, but the force-graph is a dense hairball and the three-panel layout feels cramped rather than confident.
blockbuilder-explorer.encoding_integrity_note: Correct area encoding throughout (scaleSqrt for all circle sizes), zero-baseline bar chart with data-driven domains, monthly bins via d3.utcMonth — minor metamorphic concern as network node scales dynamically recalculate on filter (subset relation fails: sizes shift relative to each other), but no fundamental encoding violations.
blockbuilder-explorer.stress_test_note: Excellent RAF dirty-flag coalescing prevents update storms across all brush events; only gap is no window resize handler, leaving x/y scales captured as stale closures if the viewport changes.
blockbuilder-explorer.cognitive_load_note: The 4-panel crossfilter layout is within working memory limits and well-organized, but the 60-node force network renders as a dense hairball with no legible cluster structure at a glance, which is the dominant perceptual failure.
